name: Bennington flag
description: Thirteen stripes, white outermost, with a tall navy canton bearing the numerals '76' beneath an arch of eleven seven-pointed stars, with one star in each upper corner.
history: Traditionally associated with the Battle of Bennington (16 August 1777), though textile analysis suggests the surviving 'Bennington flag' is a 19th-century commemorative — possibly for the 1826 jubilee. Its inverted stripe order, seven-pointed stars and '76' make it one of the most distinctive American flag designs.

features.role: eleven stars arching over '76', plus one in each upper corner
